welcome.title: Welcome to the BiblioViva demo
welcome.betaText: BiblioViva is a public beta: the features are stable, but until version 1.0 an update is not guaranteed to stay compatible with the data and settings of the previous version.
welcome.intro: BiblioViva is software for running a school library: loans and returns, catalogue, patrons with photos and cards, labels, printing and reports. This is a public demo: every feature is available to try.
welcome.contents: Inside there is a made-up primary school: {{patrons}} {{patrons:plural; one:pupil or teacher; other:pupils and teachers;}}, {{biblios}} {{biblios:plural; one:title; other:titles;}} and {{items}} {{items:plural; one:copy; other:copies;}}, {{openLoans}} {{openLoans:plural; one:loan; other:loans;}} in progress, {{overdueLoans}} of them overdue. Names and photos are made up: no real person.
welcome.reset: Every day at {{time}} the demo goes back to how it started. Configuration changes can be tried but are not saved.
welcome.examples: In the demo, text and pictures are replaced by an example: every operation can be tried to the end, but what is typed or photographed is not kept and no other visitor sees it. The imports accept only the example files, downloaded from the page of each import.
welcome.accountsTitle: Which account to sign in with
welcome.accountsHint: As in the library, each account sees only the work of its role. User name and password go in the form above.
welcome.password: The password is the same for every account:

admin.name: Administration
admin.does: sees everything: besides the work of the other accounts, the configuration, the staff accounts, backups, classes and the move to the next school year.

prestiti.name: Loan management
prestiti.does: the loan desk: lends, returns and renews, follows the overdue loans and prints the reminders.

catalogo.name: Cataloguing
catalogo.does: books and copies, record lookup from SBN (simulated here), covers, classification and labels.

tessere.name: Cards and photos
tessere.does: pupils and teachers, photos and the photo census of the classes, card printing.

report.name: Reports
report.does: statistics on loans, catalogue and patrons, table exports.

blocked.config: In the demo the configuration is not saved: everything can be tried, but changes are not written.
blocked.restore: In the demo restoring a backup is off: the demo data are built again by themselves every night.
blocked.configImport: In the demo importing a configuration is off: the demo's configuration is the same for every visitor.
blocked.pictures: The demo does not upload class pictures: try the census with the example class picture.
blocked.sqlReports: In the demo reports written in SQL are off: try the guided reports.
blocked.importSize: In the demo files to import may be 1 MB at most.
blocked.printSize: In the demo at most 3 sheets are printed at a time: choose fewer copies or fewer patrons.
blocked.importExample: The demo imports its example file only: download it with the template button and upload it as it is.
blocked.notesLimit: In the demo only a few notes a day can be written.
blocked.demoData: In the demo the sample data stay until the nightly reset.
blocked.backups: In the demo manual backups are off: the demo data are built again by themselves every night.
blocked.archives: In the demo archives and backups are not downloaded: the demo's data and configuration are built again every night.
blocked.languagePacks: In the demo language packs are not downloaded: the demo has Italian and English.

demoPublic.replaced: In the demo, text and pictures are replaced by an example: the save went through, but the example is kept.
demoPublic.tooMany: Too many requests in a short time: try again in a minute.
